title: First eight, then "a dalších"
summary: Answers with 12 or more people show only the first 8 chips, followed by a blue "a dalších 21" chip that expands the rest in place ("Méně" collapses it again); smaller answers stay complete. The 29-person top answer shrinks from four phone screens to about one.
tradeoffs: Keeps the familiar chips and every name one tap away, but the full crowd behind a big answer is hidden by default.
